elements.element: Services are performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(1) expressly warrants that the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards.

elements.element: Deliverables and software conform to the applicable documentation.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(2) covers only the Site, rather than all deliverables and software, and requires conformity only “in all material respects,” leaving other provided software and immaterial nonconformities outside the warranty.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty has a 12-month duration.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(2) expressly provides a twelve-month Site conformance period following the Effective Date. The period is not tied to delivery or acceptance, but the preferred position specifies only the duration, not a different commencement trigger.

elements.element: The professional and workmanlike Services warranty has a 90-day duration.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(1) contains no express 90-day warranty period or other duration for the Services warranty.

elements.element: Repair is available as a remedy for breach of the performance or conformance warranty.
elements.evidence: The concluding sentence expressly provides repair as a remedy, although HDI controls the remedy election.

elements.element: Replacement is available as a remedy for breach of the performance or conformance warranty.
elements.evidence: The concluding sentence expressly provides replacement as a remedy, although HDI controls the remedy election.

elements.element: Refund is available as a remedy for breach of the performance or conformance warranty.
elements.evidence: The concluding sentence permits a refund of fees paid for the nonconforming Services or affected portion of the Site, although HDI controls the remedy election.

elements.element: The Services are performed in compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(3) expressly warrants performance of the Services in compliance with all applicable laws, rules, and regulations.

elements.element: The Site, deliverables, and provided software contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(4) warrants that the Site and any software or files provided or made accessible to the Company will be free of viruses, worms, and other malicious or disabling code.

result.reason: The redline is confined to the requested warranty subject and preserves the existing provisions. It includes the principal performance, legal-compliance, malicious-code, remedy, and 12-month Site warranty terms. Neither level is complete, however, because the Services warranty has no required duration and the conformance warranty is limited to the Site and to material conformity rather than covering all deliverables/software without that qualification.
